prompts.name: 01-wordmark
prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Design one premium original logo concept for IDIBAGES, an enterprise ERP platform for Central African businesses. Exact text: "IDIBAGES" spelled I D I B A G E S. Flat vector-like crisp graphic, sophisticated custom sans-serif typography, horizontal logo lockup centered with generous transparent negative space. Colors only charcoal #242424 and burnt orange #B94724; background truly transparent. Absolutely NO enclosing container, square, rounded-square, circle badge, border, tile, app icon background, mockup, shadows, gradients, extra slogans, or watermarks. Direction 1: pure typographic wordmark, no separate icon. Bold contemporary architectural lettering, one elegantly customized burnt-orange G with an open angular terminal suggests forward movement. Remaining letters charcoal. Beautiful consistent kerning.
